plan.why: It is only pages and needs no server of its own, so it goes online as it is.

left.text: It has no llocal.json yet: the short file that tells llocal how to build and start it.

changes.detail: llocal puts the pages online as they are, behind sign-in.

outside.detail: No setting holds its key, so the key stays where it is in the code, if it has one. Visitors' browsers talk to it directly.

tell.where: Google Cloud console > APIs & Services > Credentials > the key > Website restrictions: add the new address
